t: A free slicer that turns 3D models into printer instructions.
steps: Download PrusaSlicer from the official site.
Ask IT to approve the install on Windows 10 or later, macOS, or Linux.
Choose the stable release. A 3.0.0 alpha exists but is not advised for production.
Slice a model and check the preview.
Send it by SD card or the local network.
Print a test and review it with students.
